resale_co.name: Existing Structure Certificate of Occupancy (resale)
resale_co.issued_by: Little Egg Harbor Township Construction Office (Construction Code Official)
requirements: House numbers permanently attached: 3 inches for homes
Deadbolts may not need a key on the inside
Smoke alarms on each floor including the basement and within 10 feet of all bedrooms; interconnected systems must stay interconnected
Carbon monoxide alarms outside of and within 10 feet of all bedrooms
Relief valves on water heaters and boilers piped down to 2 to 6 inches from the floor, no reducers, no threads at the bottom, no plastic unless allowed by the plumbing code
Dryer exhaust of metal flex or rigid pipe, vented outside
Water on, with hot on the left and cold on the right
Plumbing in good condition with no open sewer or gas lines
Covers on all light fixtures, switches, outlets, junction boxes and panels; no gaps in breaker or fuse boxes; service mast, meter socket and panel in good condition
Fire extinguisher (2A-10B:C, mounted near the kitchen) is only required for rentals
Signed mechanical certificate that the heating unit, hot water unit and electrical systems are safe (owner, buyer, licensed contractor or home inspector)

fees.label: Resale inspection (table row: Resale / Fee / Re-Inspection Fee)

resale_co.how_to_apply: Download the Existing Structure Certificate of Occupancy application (residential), check 'Resale', and submit the complete packet with the fee, the signed Mechanical Certification, and any required prior approvals (open permits closed, LLC formation letter, estate Surrogate letter or POA, well water analysis if on a well). Incomplete applications are not accepted. Once accepted, the office emails an inspection date (check spam folders). The form asks for a lock box code or that someone be home. If the buyer will obtain the certificate, the seller and buyer sign the notarized acknowledgements on page 5. Construction Office, 665 Radio Road, Little Egg Harbor, NJ 08087; phone 609-294-9071, fax 609-294-9065.

evidence.quote: Pursuant to Little Egg Harbor Township Ordinance 2001-14 and 8-10.0 all properties sold and rented shall have their heating unit, hot water unit, plumbing and electrical system inspected and certified. Then the certification has to be delivered to the construction code official before Certificate of Inspection/ Occupancy can be issued.
the responsibilities of submitting and obtaining a resale certificate of occupancy, waiving the seller's responsibilities of the process.
All applicable prior approvals must be submitted BEFORE this application will be accepted
Once the application has been accepted, the office will process and you will receive and email with an inspection date.
Existing Structure Certificate of Occupancy Application (Residential)
Ronald Piszar, Construction Official/Fire Sub-Code Official

resale_co.notes: The same application covers resale ($60), rental ($50) and short-term rental ($50) inspections; the fee table was read visually from the scanned form (revised 2/24/2026). The Zoning & Code Enforcement page also lists Frederick Cramer, Housing Inspector, (609) 296-7241 ext.161, and zoning@leht.com / codeenforcement@leht.com. Rentals also need a Rental Mercantile License, liability insurance and a Landlord Filing Statement, and short-term rentals have their own application (Ordinance 2023-05); those are rental rules, not sale rules. Lead time and how long the certificate is valid are not stated.

fire_cert.notes: The NJ DCA Division of Fire Safety is Little Egg Harbor's fire code enforcing agency (LEA registry code S; directory Fire Official Louis Kilmer, (609)633-6132). The DCA state-towns list (revised 7/17/2026) shows Little Egg Harbor without the 'SC' flag, so the state does not appear to issue smoke certificates here, and the Township's resale Certificate of Occupancy inspection checks smoke and CO alarms. Under N.J.A.C. 5:70-2.3 a municipal resale inspection can stand in for the separate state certificate. No Township page says this in so many words, so confirm with the Construction Office. The three volunteer fire companies (Mystic Island, Parkertown, West Tuckerton) do not issue certificates.
